The Coca-Cola Company ( KO ) closed at $92.71 on Friday, October 23, down 2.76% from its October 22 close of $95.34. October 22 was also the day it touched a 52-week intraday high of $95.37. No company-specific catalyst was reported. According to CNBC, the Dow fell more than 600 points as oil prices rose, and consumer staples, utilities and healthcare were all lower.

The pullback trims a 32.6% price gain since the end of 2025, ahead of third-quarter results on Tuesday, October 27, before the open. The last report showed where the pressure sits: India.

Asia Pacific Added the Most Volume and Lost Share to India

Second-quarter results for Asia Pacific:

The longer record points the same way. In reported U.S. dollars, not adjusted for currency, Asia Pacific operating income fell from $2.325 billion in 2021 to $2.042 billion in 2025. Its revenue rose from $5.291 billion to $5.638 billion over the same years. By comparison, North America grew operating income from $3.331 billion to $5.070 billion, and Latin America from $2.534 billion to $3.742 billion.

Braun’s India Playbook Favors Volume Over Price

At Barclays’ Global Consumer Conference on September 9, Barclays analyst Lauren Lieberman asked CEO Henrique Braun what success in India looks like without overreacting to competitive pressures. Braun said the task is “how you don’t overreact to noise, but really act on the signals.” Speaking generally about a developing market, he said Coca-Cola “might lose share in one quarter here,” or face a rival pricing irrationally.

His prescription is the fundamentals: the right packaging architecture and brands, built on revenue growth management, and sticking to that plan. He added that seven of the top 10 brands in India are Coca-Cola’s, three of them local brands acquired in the past. If that plan keeps leaning on affordability, as the second quarter’s affordability initiatives suggest, Asia Pacific volume can keep rising while price/mix stays negative.

The mid case is a price return that excludes the stock’s 2.3% dividend yield. The model’s 2025 to 2035 forecast assumes revenue growth of around 3% a year and a net income margin of around 31%.

Coca-Cola trades at around 27 times forward earnings, against about 16 times for PepsiCo (PEP) and about 14 times for Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP). The return therefore depends on earnings growth rather than a higher multiple. The Street’s mean target of around $95 sits about 3% above the close.

Upside would come from Asia Pacific price/mix turning positive while volume holds. Further India share losses alongside a fading premium could leave the stock flat for years. A loss in the long-running IRS tax dispute is the main company-specific risk.

Price/mix better than the second quarter’s negative 9%, with volume still growing and no repeat of the India share loss, would suggest affordability spending is starting to pay. Another deep negative alongside another India loss would mean the region adding the most volume is still holding back margins.

Two items sit outside these numbers. KFC’s U.S. restaurants switch to Coca-Cola starting in January 2027. Separately, Semafor reported on October 8 that Coca-Cola is again exploring a sale of Costa Coffee, which Coca-Cola did not comment on.

可口可乐公司 (KO) 10 月 23 日星期五收盘价为 92.71 美元，较 10 月 22 日收盘价 95.34 美元下跌 2.76%。 10 月 22 日，它也触及 52 周盘中高点 95.37 美元。没有报道公司特定的催化剂。据 CNBC 报道，随着油价上涨，道琼斯指数下跌逾 600 点，消费必需品、公用事业和医疗保健均走低。

在 10 月 27 日星期二开盘前发布第三季度业绩之前，此次回调削减了自 2025 年底以来 32.6% 的股价涨幅。上一份报告显示了压力所在：印度。

亚太地区增加量最多，但印度失去的份额

亚太地区第二季度业绩：

较长的记录也以同样的方式指向。以未进行货币调整的美元计算，亚太地区营业收入从 2021 年的 23.25 亿美元下降至 2025 年的 20.42 亿美元。同年其收入从 52.91 亿美元增至 56.38 亿美元。相比之下，北美地区的营业收入从 33.31 亿美元增加到 50.7 亿美元，拉丁美洲从 25.34 亿美元增加到 37.42 亿美元。

博朗的印度策略重在数量而非价格

在 9 月 9 日举行的巴克莱全球消费者大会上，巴克莱分析师劳伦·利伯曼 (Lauren Lieberman) 询问首席执行官恩里克·布劳恩 (Henrique Braun)，在不对竞争压力反应过度的情况下，在印度取得成功是什么样的。布劳恩说，任务是“如何不对噪音反应过度，而是真正根据信号采取行动。”在谈到发展中市场时，他表示可口可乐“可能会在一个季度内失去市场份额”，或者面临竞争对手的不合理定价。

他的处方是基本原则：正确的包装架构和品牌，建立在收入增长管理的基础上，并坚持该计划。他补充说，印度十大品牌中有七个是可口可乐的，其中三个是过去收购的本土品牌。如果该计划继续依赖于可负担性，正如第二季度的可负担性举措所表明的那样，亚太地区的销量可以继续增长，而价格/组合仍为负数。

中间情况是不包括股票 2.3% 股息收益率的价格回报。该模型对 2025 年至 2035 年的预测假设收入每年增长 3% 左右，净利润率约为 31%。

可口可乐的预期市盈率约为 27 倍，而百事可乐 (PEP) 约为 16 倍，Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) 约为 14 倍。因此，回报取决于盈利增长而不是更高的倍数。华尔街的平均目标价约为 95 美元，较收盘价高出约 3%。

上行将来自亚太地区价格/组合转正而成交量保持不变。印度股价进一步下跌以及溢价下降可能导致该股多年持平。长期存在的国税局税务纠纷造成的损失是公司特有的主要风险。

价格/组合好于第二季度的负 9%，销量仍在增长，并且印度份额的损失没有重演，这表明负担能力支出开始产生回报。另一个严重的负面影响以及印度的另一个损失将意味着该地区增加的销量仍然会抑制利润率。

有两个项目位于这些数字之外。肯德基的美国餐厅从 2027 年 1 月开始改用可口可乐。另外，Semafor 于 10 月 8 日报道称，可口可乐正在再次考虑出售 Costa 咖啡，但可口可乐没有对此发表评论。
